values: The allies urgently need to move supplies of food and ammunition to the front-line. You are required to escort the convoy and guard against enemy air attack. You may return to base after reaching waypoint x.
The destruction of the enemy helicopters and the saving of the vital supply convoy has enabled our troops to sustain their attack. Congratulations on a job well done.
The supply convoy has reached its destination intact. Your contribution on this mission  was much appreciated.
Your failure to protect the vital convoy has had a devastating effect on allied morale.  Without the necessary supply of food and ammunition, our front-line troops will suffer greatly.
